namespaces.description: List that contains each combination of database, collection, and type on the specified host.

NamespaceObj.description: Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`.

namespace.description: Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`.

type.description: Human-readable label that identifies the type of namespace.
